Needed: A Zigbee or Z-Wave USB stick, for devices that are not on Wi-Fi for ThinkPad home automation server
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "for parts only", "wifi only", "bluetooth only", "433mhz only"], "pattern": "z(?:igbee|[-\\s]?wave).{0,20}usb|usb.{0,20}z(?:igbee|[-\\s]?wave)", "phrasings": [{"text": "Zigbee USB stick", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Zigbee+USB+stick", "why": "Finds plain-name listings for Zigbee coordinator sticks that other phrasings miss."}, {"text": "Z-Wave USB dongle", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Z-Wave+USB+dongle", "why": "Finds Z-Wave side of the need worded as dongle instead of stick."}, {"text": "Zigbee coordinator adapter", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Zigbee+coordinator+adapter", "why": "Finds home-automation server wording focused on coordinator function."}, {"text": "Zwave controller stick", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Zwave+controller+stick", "why": "Finds sellers who write Zwave without hyphen and call it a controller."}, {"text": "Zigby USB dongle", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=Zigby+USB+dongle", "why": "Catches common misspelling Zigby listings that correct spellings miss."}]}
